name: ui-kpi
description: Key figures as small tiles: label, value, a line below, trend arrow, theme colour, sizes; ui-kpi-group lays them out in a responsive grid.

descriptions.--ui-kpi-gap: Space between label, value and the line below.
descriptions.--ui-kpi-border-width: Border width of a tile (0: none).
descriptions.--ui-kpi-value-font-size: Font size of the value (size sm and lg scale it).
descriptions.--ui-kpi-sub-color: Colour of the line below the value.
descriptions.--ui-kpi-sub-font-size: Font size of the line below the value.
descriptions.--ui-kpi-group-min: ui-kpi-group: the narrowest a tile gets before the grid wraps.
